statement: Zero-shot, one-shot and few-shot prompting
value: Brown et al. (2020), "Language Models are Few-Shot Learners" (arXiv 2005.14165): zero-shot gives the model only a natural-language instruction and no demonstrations; one-shot gives exactly one demonstration plus the instruction; few-shot gives as many demonstrations as fit in the context (typically 10 to 100)
source_title: Brown et al. (2020), Language Models are Few-Shot Learners, arXiv 2005.14165
notes: arxiv.org is unreachable from the build container; the zero-shot sentence is quoted from the paper via search text. A bare prompt with no example is zero-shot, not one-shot (Fall 2026 Session 2).
